description: This file implements the MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService class and related factory functions for managing media key system capabilities in an IPC-based server environment. It includes methods for client connection handling, querying supported key systems, and retrieving key system versions, utilizing protobuf and IPC controller interfaces.

classes.name: IMediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService instances.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService
classes.description: Implements the media keys capabilities service, handling client connections and key system queries.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory for MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService instances.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService instance with a given ICdmService.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles a new client connection, exporting the service.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Retrieves supported key systems from the CDM service and responds to the client.

methods.name: supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a specific key system is supported.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a supported key system.
